content.text:
I've submitted index 25 (Cr 0.16, Sb 0.84) as the best composition, with 0.122% EQE. That uses up the 3 merit measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | 0.52 | 0.013 |
| 21 | 0.74 | 0.074 |
| 25 | 0.84 | 0.122 |

EQE rose steadily as the Sb fraction went up. It was still climbing at index 25, so the true best may be at indices 26 or 27 (Sb 0.86–0.87), which I didn't have budget to measure. I also didn't measure anything with more than about half Cr, since the trend pointed the other way. All 5 XRD measurements went unused, so no phase identification backs this choice.
